# The test tools CI adds to requirements.lock in the pytest shards and the
# fuzz job, hash-pinned so the install is `pip install --require-hashes -r`
# (OpenSSF Scorecard's Pinned-Dependencies). The same tools are in the
# `dev` extra (pyproject.toml) for a local `pip install -e ".[dev]"`; they
# are test-only and never installed with Domovoi.
#   hypothesis (MPL-2.0, test-only; owner rule 2026-11-15) + sortedcontainers
#   (Apache-2.0): the property tests (domovoi/tests/test_fuzz_parsers.py).
#   coverage (Apache-2.0) + pytest-cov (MIT): the coverage report.
# Python 3.12 on the Linux x86_64 runner only (the hypothesis and coverage
# hashes are that one wheel each); pytest and pluggy come from
# requirements.lock. Every version is at least 14 days old. To bump: take
# the new version's sha256 from its PyPI page (Download files).
